text:
Which statement about electrical safety is correct?
A
If a device is double insulated, it does not need a fuse.
B
A device that has a normal operating current of 3.0A must be protected by a 3.0A fuse.
C
Switches must always be connected into the live supply wire.
D
The metal casing of an electrical device must be connected to the neutral wire.

options.label: A
options.text: If a device is double insulated, it does not need a fuse.

options.label: B
options.text: A device that has a normal operating current of 3.0A must be protected by a 3.0A fuse.

options.label: C
options.text: Switches must always be connected into the live supply wire.

options.label: D
options.text: The metal casing of an electrical device must be connected to the neutral wire.
